observations.footwork: Both fighters moving laterally across the gym floor, with forward and backward shuffling steps
observations.guard: Hands held up in a boxing guard throughout
observations.upper_body: Slight bobbing and weaving, torso rotating with movement
observations.distance: Medium range, maintaining distance with light footwork
observations.notable: Moving as a pair, one stepping in as the other steps back

observations.footwork: Lead foot steps forward to generate power for the punch
observations.guard: Lead hand extends while rear hand remains up in guard
observations.upper_body: Torso rotation visible, punching arm fully extended towards the target
observations.distance: Medium range, punch is thrown as the other fighter shifts back
observations.notable: A left hand punch is extended and then recovered

observations.footwork: Backpedaling and resetting, taking smaller steps
observations.guard: Both hands return to a high guard position
observations.upper_body: Recovery and slight reset, less upper body movement
observations.distance: Distance opens slightly as they reset
observations.notable: A brief pause or slow-down in the action

movement_events.detail: Lateral shuffling and footwork as the pair moves around the area
Left hand punch is extended towards the target
Punch is retracted back to the guard position
Fighters reset their position and backpedal
